intent.proves: Every BOM line points at a component product that exists or, when it names a group, at a product group that exists.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(i.ProductItemProductId AS nvarchar(50)) + N' -> ' + CAST(ISNULL(NULLIF(i.ProductItemBomProductId, N''), i.ProductItemBomGroupId) AS nvarchar(100)) FROM EcomProductItems i WHERE (ISNULL(i.ProductItemBomGroupId, N'') = N'' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts c WHERE c.ProductId = i.ProductItemBomProductId)) OR (ISNULL(i.ProductItemBomGroupId, N'') <> N'' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomGroups g WHERE g.GroupId = i.ProductItemBomGroupId))
